name: mcp-apps-probe
description: MCP Apps probe and quiet inline Anki reviews for Codex desktop.

interface.shortDescription: Review Anki cards inline without chat turns.
interface.longDescription: Review due and new Anki cards inline. The widget sends ratings directly to a local MCP tool, records them through AnkiConnect, and shows the next card without posting a chat message. Includes a harmless counter probe for testing quiet tool calls.
interface.defaultPrompt: Help me start a quiet inline Anki review using the MCP App.
